dremio:position-deletes:v2.notes: Dremio reads and writes Iceberg v2 position delete files for DELETE, UPDATE, and MERGE INTO operations when table properties write.delete.mode, write.update.mode, or write.merge.mode are set to 'merge-on-read', and compacts them via OPTIMIZE TABLE.
caveats: Default write mode is copy-on-write; merge-on-read must be enabled via table properties to write position delete files

dremio:position-deletes:v3.notes: In Iceberg v3, position delete files are replaced by Puffin binary deletion vectors, which Dremio writes for merge-on-read DML operations while continuing to read legacy v2 position delete files after upgrading a table to v3.
caveats: V3 replaces position delete files with Puffin deletion vectors on write

links.label: Dremio Cloud Changelog (Iceberg v3 Deletion Vectors)

dremio:equality-deletes:v2.notes: Not supported as a write operation. Dremio's DML statements (DELETE, UPDATE, MERGE) write copy-on-write data files or position delete files rather than equality delete files. On the read and maintenance paths, Dremio reads both partition-scoped and global equality delete files written by external engines such as Apache Flink (DX-54685, DX-104673) and rewrites/compacts them during OPTIMIZE TABLE (DX-88786).
caveats: Rated on write capability: Dremio does not write equality delete files, though it reads partition-scoped and global equality deletes and compacts them via OPTIMIZE TABLE

links.label: Dremio 26.x Release Notes (Global Equality Deletes & OPTIMIZE)

dremio:equality-deletes:v3.notes: Not supported as a write operation. Dremio uses Puffin deletion vectors or copy-on-write for row-level mutations on Iceberg v3 tables rather than writing equality delete files, while reading existing equality deletes written by external engines.
caveats: Rated on write capability: Dremio does not write equality delete files

dremio:merge-on-read:v2.notes: Full support for merge-on-read on DELETE, UPDATE, and MERGE INTO via table properties write.delete.mode, write.update.mode, and write.merge.mode = 'merge-on-read', writing position delete files and merging them at read time or during OPTIMIZE TABLE.
caveats: Copy-on-write is the default; merge-on-read is configured per operation via TBLPROPERTIES

dremio:merge-on-read:v3.notes: Full merge-on-read support on Iceberg v3 tables using Puffin-based binary deletion vectors (DX-105396, DX-118097) for DELETE, UPDATE, and MERGE INTO when configured for merge-on-read.
caveats: Copy-on-write is the default; merge-on-read is configured per operation via TBLPROPERTIES

links.label: Dremio Cloud Changelog (Iceberg v3 Deletion Vectors)

dremio:copy-on-write:v2.notes: Copy-on-write is Dremio's default write mode for DELETE, UPDATE, and MERGE INTO on Iceberg v2 tables (write.delete.mode, write.update.mode, write.merge.mode default to 'copy-on-write').

dremio:copy-on-write:v3.notes: Copy-on-write is supported and defaults to enabled for DELETE, UPDATE, and MERGE INTO on Iceberg v3 tables.

dremio:schema-evolution:v2.notes: Full metadata-only schema evolution via ALTER TABLE ... ADD COLUMNS, DROP COLUMN, and ALTER/CHANGE COLUMN (rename or type change) without rewriting data files.

dremio:schema-evolution:v3.notes: Full schema evolution via ALTER TABLE ... ADD COLUMNS (including DEFAULT values), DROP COLUMN, and CHANGE COLUMN on Iceberg v3 tables.

dremio:type-promotion:v2.notes: Supports all standard Iceberg v2 type widenings via ALTER TABLE ... CHANGE COLUMN: INT to BIGINT, FLOAT to DOUBLE, and DECIMAL(P, S) precision expansion without rewriting data files.

dremio:type-promotion:v3.notes: Supports standard Iceberg v2 type widenings (INT to BIGINT, FLOAT to DOUBLE, DECIMAL precision increase) on v3 tables, but does not yet support v3-specific type promotions such as int/long to timestamp or string to variant.
caveats: Only V2 numeric/decimal widenings are supported; V3-new type promotions are not yet implemented

dremio:column-default-values:v2.notes: Column default values (initial-default and write-default) are an Iceberg v3 specification feature and are not available in v2.

dremio:column-default-values:v3.notes: Full support for Iceberg v3 column default values (DX-103780), allowing DEFAULT expressions on CREATE TABLE and ALTER TABLE ... ADD COLUMNS and applying write defaults when omitted on INSERT.

links.label: Dremio Cloud Changelog (Iceberg v3 Column Default Values)

dremio:table-creation:v2.notes: Full DDL support via CREATE TABLE and CREATE TABLE AS SELECT (CTAS) with PARTITION BY, LOCALSORT BY, LOCATION, and TBLPROPERTIES (default format-version is 2).

dremio:table-creation:v3.notes: Full DDL support via CREATE TABLE and CTAS with TBLPROPERTIES ('format-version' = '3'), including v3 data types, default values, row lineage, and deletion vector properties.

dremio:hidden-partitioning:v2.notes: Full support for Iceberg hidden partitioning via PARTITION BY with identity, year(), month(), day(), hour(), bucket(N, col), and truncate(N, col) transforms and automatic partition pruning at query time.

dremio:hidden-partitioning:v3.notes: Full support for Iceberg hidden partitioning transforms (identity, year, month, day, hour, bucket, truncate) on Iceberg v3 tables.

dremio:partition-evolution:v2.notes: Full metadata-only partition spec evolution via ALTER TABLE ... ADD PARTITION FIELD and DROP PARTITION FIELD without rewriting existing data files; queries prune seamlessly across historical and current partition specs.

dremio:partition-evolution:v3.notes: Full partition evolution via ALTER TABLE ... ADD PARTITION FIELD and DROP PARTITION FIELD on Iceberg v3 tables.

dremio:multi-arg-transforms:v2.notes: Multi-argument partition transforms are an Iceberg v3 specification feature and do not apply to v2.

dremio:multi-arg-transforms:v3.notes: Dremio's PARTITION BY syntax supports single-column Iceberg transforms (identity, year, month, day, hour, bucket(N, col), truncate(N, col)); multi-argument transforms are not yet supported in DDL.
caveats: Only single-column partition transforms can be declared in Dremio SQL

dremio:time-travel:v2.notes: Full SQL time-travel and rollback support via SELECT ... AT SNAPSHOT '<id>', AT TIMESTAMP '<ts>', AT BRANCH '<name>', AT TAG '<name>', and ROLLBACK TABLE ... TO SNAPSHOT / TIMESTAMP, plus table_history(), table_snapshot(), and table_manifests() metadata functions.

dremio:time-travel:v3.notes: Full SQL time-travel (AT SNAPSHOT, AT TIMESTAMP, AT BRANCH, AT TAG) and ROLLBACK TABLE support on Iceberg v3 tables.

dremio:table-maintenance:v2.notes: Comprehensive SQL maintenance and automated catalog maintenance: OPTIMIZE TABLE ... REWRITE DATA (bin-pack or sort, compacting position and equality deletes) and REWRITE MANIFESTS, VACUUM TABLE ... EXPIRE SNAPSHOTS and REMOVE ORPHAN FILES, plus zero-touch automated background compaction and vacuuming in Dremio Open Catalog.

dremio:table-maintenance:v3.notes: Full OPTIMIZE TABLE (REWRITE DATA and REWRITE MANIFESTS) and VACUUM TABLE (EXPIRE SNAPSHOTS and REMOVE ORPHAN FILES) support on Iceberg v3 tables, preserving row lineage and compacting deletion vectors.

dremio:branching-tagging:v2.notes: Supports both table-level Iceberg branches and tags (CREATE/ALTER/DROP BRANCH/TAG, AT BRANCH, AT TAG) and catalog-level Git-like branching, tagging, and merging.

dremio:branching-tagging:v3.notes: Supports Iceberg branches and tags on v3 tables as well as catalog-level branching and tagging.

dremio:read-support:v2.notes: High-performance vectorized Apache Arrow execution engine with Columnar Cloud Cache (C3), Autonomous Reflections, partition/manifest/row-group pruning, predicate pushdown, and full reading of v2 position and equality deletes (including global equality deletes, DX-54685).

dremio:read-support:v3.notes: Full vectorized read support for Iceberg v3 tables, including Puffin deletion vector resolution, row lineage columns (_row_id, _last_updated_sequence_number), VARIANT (with shredded sub-column pushdown), UUID, TIMESTAMP(9), and column default values.

dremio:write-insert:v2.notes: Full write support via INSERT INTO, CREATE TABLE AS SELECT (CTAS), and COPY INTO (CSV, JSON, Parquet) with LOCALSORT BY and configurable target file sizes.

dremio:write-insert:v3.notes: Full INSERT INTO, CTAS, and COPY INTO support on Iceberg v3 tables, maintaining v3 row lineage and column default values.

dremio:write-merge-update-delete:v2.notes: Full SQL DML support for MERGE INTO, UPDATE, and DELETE on Iceberg v2 tables in both copy-on-write and merge-on-read (position delete) modes.

dremio:write-merge-update-delete:v3.notes: Full SQL DML support for MERGE INTO, UPDATE, and DELETE on Iceberg v3 tables in both copy-on-write and merge-on-read (Puffin deletion vector) modes while preserving row lineage.

links.label: Dremio Cloud Changelog (Iceberg v3 Deletion Vectors)

dremio:catalog-integration:v2.notes: Extensive native catalog integrations: built-in Dremio Open Catalog (powered by Apache Polaris), generic Iceberg REST Catalog, AWS Glue Data Catalog, Amazon S3 Tables, Snowflake Open/Horizon Catalog, Microsoft OneLake, Google Cloud Lakehouse, Databricks Unity Catalog, Nessie, Hive Metastore, and file/object storage catalogs.

dremio:catalog-integration:v3.notes: Catalog integrations support Iceberg v3 tables across Dremio Open Catalog, generic Iceberg REST Catalogs, AWS Glue, Snowflake Open Catalog, Databricks Unity Catalog, Google Cloud Lakehouse, and object storage sources.

dremio:statistics:v2.notes: Dremio automatically collects and writes Iceberg column-level metrics in manifest files (write.metadata.metrics.default = truncate(16), write.metadata.metrics.max-inferred-column-defaults = 100), populates missing statistics during OPTIMIZE TABLE (DX-105933), and uses manifest metrics for cost-based scan planning, partition/file pruning, metadata-driven COUNT(*)/MIN/MAX (DX-100737, DX-101826), and ORDER BY ... LIMIT pruning (DX-116991).
caveats: Manual ANALYZE TABLE is not supported on Iceberg tables (DX-88922); statistics are maintained automatically on writes and OPTIMIZE TABLE

dremio:statistics:v3.notes: Full automatic manifest column metrics collection and query-time pruning on Iceberg v3 tables, including per-subcolumn statistics for shredded VARIANT fields.
caveats: Manual ANALYZE TABLE is not supported on Iceberg tables (DX-88922); statistics are maintained automatically on writes and OPTIMIZE TABLE

dremio:bloom-filters:v2.notes: Added in Dremio 26.1.0 (DX-100948): supports configuring and writing Parquet column bloom filters via Iceberg table properties write.parquet.bloom-filter-enabled.column.<col>, write.parquet.bloom-filter-max-bytes (default 1MB), and write.parquet.bloom-filter-fpp.column.<col> (default 0.01), and uses them for data skipping during scans.
caveats: Bloom filters are opt-in per column via write.parquet.bloom-filter-enabled.column.<col>

dremio:bloom-filters:v3.notes: Supports Parquet column bloom filters via write.parquet.bloom-filter-enabled.column.<col>, write.parquet.bloom-filter-max-bytes, and write.parquet.bloom-filter-fpp.column.<col> (DX-100948), and reads/writes Puffin files for v3 deletion vectors (DX-105396, DX-118097).
caveats: Bloom filters are opt-in per column via write.parquet.bloom-filter-enabled.column.<col>

dremio:aws-glue-catalog:v2.notes: First-class native AWS Glue Data Catalog connector and AWS Glue Iceberg REST Catalog support (including IAM assume-role, DX-115580) with full read/write DDL, DML, and table maintenance.

dremio:aws-glue-catalog:v3.notes: Full read and write support for Iceberg v3 tables in AWS Glue Data Catalog and AWS Glue Iceberg REST Catalog.

dremio:rest-catalog:v2.notes: First-class native Iceberg REST Catalog support via the built-in Dremio Open Catalog (powered by Apache Polaris, DX-96982) and the generic Iceberg REST Catalog connector (DX-102149) with OAuth2 authentication, bearer tokens, vended storage credentials, and full read/write DDL and DML.

dremio:rest-catalog:v3.notes: Full read and write support for Iceberg v3 tables over the built-in Dremio Open Catalog (Apache Polaris) and generic Iceberg REST Catalog sources.

dremio:unity-catalog:v2.notes: Dremio supports full Iceberg REST Catalog integration (DX-102149) plus a dedicated Databricks Unity Catalog connector (DX-96951, DX-107914) with Personal Access Token and Microsoft Entra ID authentication and vended storage credentials. Native Iceberg tables in Unity Catalog can be read and written over Unity's Iceberg REST endpoint; read-only restrictions apply only when Unity Catalog itself blocks writes (such as Delta tables exposed via UniForm or the legacy Unity endpoint).
caveats: Read-only applies only to tables where Unity Catalog itself restricts writes (such as Delta Lake tables with UniForm enabled)

links.label: Dremio 26.x Release Notes (Unity Catalog & Iceberg REST)

dremio:unity-catalog:v3.notes: Connects to Databricks Unity Catalog for Iceberg v3 tables through the standard Iceberg REST Catalog protocol and Unity Catalog connector with vended credentials; read/write is supported for native Unity Iceberg tables and read-only where Unity restricts writes (e.g., Delta UniForm).
caveats: Read-only applies only to tables where Unity Catalog itself restricts writes (such as Delta Lake tables with UniForm enabled)

links.label: Dremio 26.x Release Notes (Unity Catalog & Iceberg REST)

dremio:snowflake-horizon-catalog:v2.notes: Dremio provides a dedicated Snowflake Open Catalog source connector (DX-96947) and generic Iceberg REST Catalog integration supporting OAuth2 authentication, vended storage credentials, and full read/write DDL, DML, OPTIMIZE, and VACUUM on Apache Polaris / Snowflake Horizon Catalog tables.

dremio:snowflake-horizon-catalog:v3.notes: Supports reading and writing Iceberg v3 tables through the Snowflake Open/Horizon Catalog and Iceberg REST Catalog connectors where permitted by the catalog endpoint.

dremio:google-lakehouse:v2.notes: Dremio supports connecting to Google Cloud Lakehouse (BigLake metastore) Iceberg catalogs via Dremio's Iceberg REST Catalog connector (DX-113928, March 2026).

links.label: Dremio Cloud Changelog (Google Cloud Lakehouse Support)

dremio:google-lakehouse:v3.notes: Connects to Google Cloud Lakehouse Iceberg catalogs via Dremio's Iceberg REST Catalog connector (DX-113928) for v3 tables.

links.label: Dremio Cloud Changelog (Google Cloud Lakehouse Support)

dremio:variant-type:v2.notes: The Iceberg VARIANT data type is a v3 specification feature and is not available in format version 2.

dremio:variant-type:v3.notes: Full native support for reading and writing the Iceberg v3 binary VARIANT data type (DX-97785), including VARIANT_GET, TYPEOF, TRY_CAST, and type-inspection functions.

links.label: Dremio Cloud Changelog (Iceberg v3 Data Types)

dremio:shredded-variant:v2.notes: Shredded Variant is an Iceberg v3 specification feature and is not available in format version 2.

dremio:shredded-variant:v3.notes: Dremio automatically shreds VARIANT columns into typed Parquet sub-columns at write time on Iceberg v3 tables (with per-table configuration controls) and pushes predicates and projections down to shredded sub-column statistics during scan planning.

dremio:geometry-type:v2.notes: Geometry and Geography types are Iceberg v3 specification features and do not apply to format version 2.

dremio:geometry-type:v3.notes: Native Iceberg v3 geometry and geography column types are not yet supported in Dremio DDL (Dremio's v3 type launch in DX-97785 / DX-102694 covers VARIANT, UUID, and TIMESTAMP(9)).
caveats: Geospatial operations in Dremio currently operate on WKT/WKB/GeoJSON representations rather than native Iceberg v3 geometry/geography column types

dremio:nanosecond-timestamps:v2.notes: Nanosecond-precision timestamps are an Iceberg v3 specification feature; v2 supports microsecond precision.

dremio:nanosecond-timestamps:v3.notes: Full support for nanosecond-precision timestamps via TIMESTAMP(9) across Iceberg v3 table scans, relational operators, and SQL functions (DX-102694, June 2026).

dremio:unknown-type:v2.notes: The unknown (always-null) type is an Iceberg v3 specification feature and is not available in format version 2.

dremio:unknown-type:v3.notes: Declaring columns with the Iceberg v3 unknown type is not supported in Dremio SQL DDL.
caveats: Cannot declare unknown-type columns in Dremio DDL

dremio:lineage:v2.notes: Row lineage (_row_id and _last_updated_sequence_number) is an Iceberg v3 specification feature and is not available in format version 2.

dremio:lineage:v3.notes: Full support for Iceberg v3 Row Lineage (DX-104939, DX-102731), automatically assigning, preserving, and exposing _row_id and _last_updated_sequence_number across INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE, MERGE, and OPTIMIZE operations.

links.label: Dremio Cloud Changelog (Iceberg v3 Row Lineage)

dremio:deletion-vectors:v2.notes: Puffin-based binary deletion vectors are an Iceberg v3 specification feature; v2 uses position and equality delete files.

dremio:deletion-vectors:v3.notes: Full support for reading and writing Iceberg v3 Puffin binary deletion vectors on merge-on-read tables during DELETE, UPDATE, and MERGE INTO, with high-performance vectorized DV writing (DX-105396, DX-118097).

links.label: Dremio Cloud Changelog (Iceberg v3 Deletion Vectors)
